question: In the April 2009 trade that sent Jay Cutler from Denver to Chicago, which quarterback went to the Broncos?
explanation: Chicago also gave up its 2009 and 2010 first-round picks and a 2009 third-rounder, getting Cutler and a fifth-round pick back.

question: Randy Moss slid in the 1998 NFL Draft amid character concerns. With which overall pick did Minnesota finally take him?
explanation: The Marshall star made the Vikings look brilliant, catching 17 touchdown passes as a rookie for a 15-1 team.

question: Deion Sanders won his first Super Bowl ring after the 1994 season. Which team was he playing for?
explanation: He was Defensive Player of the Year in his lone 49ers season, then signed with Dallas and won Super Bowl 30 a year later.

question: To move up to No. 1 for Michael Vick in 2001, Atlanta sent San Diego the No. 5 pick, two more picks and which player?
explanation: The receiver and returner went west along with a 2001 third-rounder and a 2002 second-rounder; San Diego used the No. 5 pick on LaDainian Tomlinson.

question: Christian McCaffrey's 2019 campaign made him the third member of the 1,000-1,000 club for rushing and receiving yards. Alongside Roger Craig, which back had already joined it?
explanation: Faulk did it in 1999, his first season with St. Louis, a year after Craig's 1985 season had stood alone for 14 years.

question: Miami took Michigan tackle Jake Long No. 1 overall in 2008. Which defensive end did St. Louis take one pick later?
explanation: The Virginia end, son of Hall of Famer Howie Long, went just ahead of Matt Ryan at No. 3 and later won Super Bowl rings with New England and Philadelphia.

question: In which round did Pittsburgh draft Central Michigan receiver Antonio Brown in 2010?
explanation: Brown went 195th overall, three rounds after the Steelers took another receiver, Emmanuel Sanders, in that same draft.

question: Late in Super Bowl 43, an offensive holding call in the end zone gave Arizona a safety and wiped out a big Pittsburgh gain. Which Steelers lineman was flagged?
explanation: The center's penalty cut the lead to 20-16; Arizona then went ahead on Larry Fitzgerald's 64-yard touchdown before Santonio Holmes won it 27-23.

question: In October 1997, a Vikings quarterback caught his own deflected pass and scored a 3-yard touchdown against Carolina. Who was it?
explanation: Johnson's touchdown pass to himself helped Minnesota beat the Panthers 21-14 at the Metrodome; he later won Super Bowl 37 with Tampa Bay.

question: LaDainian Tomlinson was a dangerous halfback passer. How many touchdown passes did he throw in his NFL career?
explanation: He completed 8 of 12 career passes for 143 yards, and more than half of those completions went for touchdowns.
